stem:
Lavanya helps with three problems: an ant bite that stings from formic acid, soil that tests acidic, and factory wastewater that tests strongly basic before discharge.

Which set of actions correctly uses opposite natures?

options.text: Baking soda paste on the bite, lime on the acidic soil, and a carefully controlled acid treatment of the basic wastewater after testing.
Add baking soda to all factory wastewater before discharge, without checking whether each batch is acidic or basic.
Add organic matter to the acidic soil to correct its acidity.
Leave neutral soil without any nutrient care forever: neutral soil never needs fertiliser.

teacher.key_rationale: Use opposite natures: mild base on acid bite, lime on acid soil, controlled acid on basic waste after testing.
